g.text: Operational Transformation: why a concurrent delete shifts an insert
User A and User B edit the same document at the same instant
-> everything after position 3 shifts left by 1
Why: B's delete was BEFORE position 5,
so A's target position must shift too.
Without the transform: applying A's insert(at=5) directly onto B's already-shifted document
would land the new character one position too far right -- User A and User B would end up seeing DIFFERENT documents.
This is why a naive "just apply operations in arrival order" scheme breaks under real concurrency.
